title: feature-slots/1: the fixed slots of the feature view of one row
description: Printed by `mzlab-cli table slots`; the same bytes as `table_slots` of the site and `slots` of the app. Seven slots in a fixed order: structure, xic, kinetics, ms2, isotopes, uv, sim. A filled slot has evidence and its source; an empty or na slot has `fill`, the Flow step and the command that fill it, never a made-up value. `source.step` is the step that normally writes that evidence: the .mzfeat records its recipe, not one step per column. Code: crates/mzlab-feat/src/slots.rs.

output.description: The name of the table the row is read from (the file name on the CLI); null when none was given.

state.description: filled: the table holds evidence. empty: nothing yet, `fill` says what fills it. na: this table cannot hold it, `reason` says why.

reason.description: Why a slot is na; null otherwise.

evidence.description: The numbers the table has for the slot (keys by slot: structure neutral, adduct, sources; xic files, detected, filled, targeted, absent, na, rt_lo, rt_hi; kinetics points, times_min; ms2 file, purity; isotopes iso_m1, adduct, family_size; sim q1, q3); null unless filled.

source.description: Where the evidence comes from; null unless filled.

files.description: The input files behind the evidence, with their SHA-256 (empty for evidence that belongs to the table as a whole).

fill.description: What fills a slot that is not filled; null when filled.
